bio:
Franxx

*Monthly*

Franxx is a pop diva extraordinaire, legendary DJ, visionary promoter, captivating diva, and true icon whose artistry and presence have always inspired and united us all. Her spirited and boundless inversion of pop mechanics across the wide genre-defiant architecture of experimental hard dance - Franxx's signature "XuntCore" sound - is inspired, high energy, passionate, vulnerable, and limitless. 

Central to her desire for freedom is the passion for creating spaces where all queer people feel safe and inspired to be free. Franxx is the founder of XUNT, Washington DC's trans-centric hardcore dance party, as well as an organizer and resident DJ of 140+/FWB - THE fixture of DC’s Hardcore and Club scene. This XUNT icon’s range in slayage is what continues to cement her as one of the most in-demand performers in Washington DC and beyond.
